breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retained the half-shift (shift 1 1 1) from the flawed prompt, even attempting to reconcile the contradiction by calling it a 'gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack with offset.' The ground truth resolves this by specifying only a gamma-centered k-point grid (no half shift). The agent failed to remove the conflicting half-shift instruction and instead perpetuated the error.
